quests.name: First Blood
quests.text: New to the valley, $N? Then learn its first rule: the wolves are not afraid of you yet. There is a wolf run just up the north road — put down 3 Forest Wolves and come straight back. Quick work, close to home.
quests.completionText: Quick and clean. You will do fine here. Now, about those wolves at the door…

quests.name: Wolves at the Door
quests.text: The forest wolves grow bold, snapping at travelers on the north road. Thin their numbers, $N. Slay 8 Forest Wolves and the town will breathe easier.
quests.completionText: Fine work. The road feels safer already.

quests.name: The Old Wolf
quests.text: There is one wolf no trap has held: Old Greyjaw. He has taken three hounds and a stable boy's arm. He prowls the deep woods north of the wolf runs. Bring me his fang.
quests.completionText: So the old devil is dead at last. The stable boy will sleep easier — and so will I.

quests.name: Boar Trouble
quests.text: The boars in Tuskfield to the east have grown vicious, and I need their hides for salves. Hunt the Wild Boars and bring me 6 Bristly Boar Hides, $N.
quests.completionText: Good — these will keep the apothecary stocked for a fortnight.

quests.name: Webwood Silk
quests.text: The spiders in Gloomweb spin a silk that binds my poultices better than linen. Slay the lurkers and bring me 6 Webwood Silk Glands.
quests.completionText: Ah, fine specimens. The marshals will want some of this batch too.

quests.name: Bandage Run
quests.text: The town clinic is short on clean cloth. Bandits and kobolds leave scraps behind — gather 8 Linen Scraps from the vale and the dig, and I will pay fair coin.
quests.completionText: Much obliged. These will be bandages by morning.

quests.name: Trouble at the Lake
quests.text: Twenty years I have fished Stillmere, and never lost a net until those gurgling fish-men crawled out of the shallows. Drive the Mudfin back — slay 8 of them. And watch yourself: where there is one murloc, there are five.
quests.completionText: Hah! That will teach them to mind their own mudholes.

quests.name: Rats in the Mine
quests.text: We struck a fine copper vein and then those kobold vermin came boiling out of the hillside. My crew will not set foot in the dig until it is cleared. Put down 10 Tunnel Rat Diggers.
quests.completionText: Ha! Back to work, lads! You have my thanks — and my coin.

quests.name: Bandits of the Vale
quests.text: A pack of cutthroats has made camp in the southeast hills. They have robbed three wagons this week. Drive them out — slay 10 Vale Bandits.
quests.completionText: Ten fewer knives in the dark. Take this — you have earned it.

quests.name: The Ringleader
quests.text: Gorrak the Ruthless has barricaded himself in the treasury vault deep within Castle Ashwood. Take the east road to the castle and enter by the front gate, fight your way to the royal vault on the upper floors, and end him, $N.
quests.completionText: Gorrak is dead? Then the valley is free of his shadow. You have done the town a great service.

objectives.label: Gorrak the Ruthless slain in the treasury

quests.name: Serah's Trail
quests.text: Word from the castle gate says Gorrak fled to the old vault rather than face the militia in the open — but he left a lieutenant behind to hold the vale. Serah the Knife has taken what is left of his crew at Gallows Rise. End her, and the southeast hills are ours again.
quests.completionText: Serah's blade will not threaten the vale again. Whatever Gorrak is doing holed up in that castle, at least our own roads are clear.

quests.name: The Restless Dead
quests.text: The old ruin on the northeast hill was a chapel once, and its yard a resting place. Something has stirred the dead from their sleep. Grant them peace, $N — return 8 Restless Bones to the earth.
quests.completionText: May they rest now, and may the Light forgive whatever woke them.

quests.name: Whispers in the Chapel Yard
quests.text: The dead speak in fragments now — cold breath on the back of the neck, words without mouths. Gather 4 vials of Ghostly Essence from the restless bones at Mourner's Rest. I must learn what they are trying to say.
quests.completionText: These essences still murmur. I will begin the rite of naming tonight.

quests.name: Names of the Dead
quests.text: Each bone remembers a name, and names have power over what walks again. Bring me 6 sets of Bone Fragments from the undead camp — I will inscribe them on the chapel stones.
quests.completionText: Good. The names are written. Now we must quiet the call that woke them.

quests.name: Silence the Call
quests.text: The tunnel rats carry blessed tallow stolen from my stores — candles meant to ward the restless. Recover 4 Blessed Tallow from the dig, $N, before the calling spreads beyond the hill.
quests.completionText: The tallow is safe. One rite remains before the dead sleep again.

quests.name: The Rite of Rest
quests.text: Meet me at Mourner's Rest on the northeast hill. Stand within the old chapel stones while I speak the final prayer — then return, and I will bless your hands for the work ahead.
quests.completionText: It is done. The hill is quiet again. Wear these — they are consecrated for a defender of the living.

quests.name: Up from the Pass
quests.text: Welcome to Kestrel Hold, $N. Step inside the walls and report to Scout Arren in the hold yard. He will tell you what waits beyond our fences.
quests.completionText: Kesk sent you? Good. Sergeant Talma needs help with the bulls along the south fences.

quests.name: Trampled Fences
quests.text: The moor bulls have flattened another stretch of fence southwest of the hold. Slay 6 Moor Bulls before we lose the whole grazing ground, $N.
quests.completionText: That will give the fence crew room to work. Ivet has a job for you when you are ready.

quests.name: Hides for the Hold
quests.text: The night watch needs warm hides. Hunt the Moor Stalkers around Hollowmoor and bring me 6 Moor Stalker Pelts. Both packs have the thick coats we need.
quests.completionText: Six sound pelts. The watch will thank you when the frost comes. Arren has been asking after you.

quests.name: What the Cairns Let Out
quests.text: Something is moving among the stones east of Hollowmoor. Reach Cairnfield and look for signs of opened graves, then return to me. Keep clear of the dead for now, $N.
quests.completionText: Broken seals and fresh tracks. Then the old stories were warnings after all.

quests.name: Lay the Wights
quests.text: The Cairn Wights are straying farther from their graves. Lay 8 of them to rest before they find the hold road. Watch the stones; they do not stay quiet for long.
quests.completionText: The road is quieter. But Kesk fears something stronger is calling them out.

quests.name: The Barrow Revenant
quests.text: Arren saw a Barrow Revenant east of Cairnfield. It walks alone, but the lesser dead heed its call. Destroy that revenant, $N, before another grave opens.
quests.completionText: One voice silenced. Talma reports raiders gathering under the scarp; we cannot leave our flank open.

quests.name: Under the Scarp
quests.text: Frostbound Raiders are massing beneath Windward Scarp to the north. Slay 6 of them and break their advance. Leave their warlord alone; we need the road clear, not a glorious funeral.
quests.completionText: Their advance is broken. Report to Kesk. He means to strike at the source beneath the cairns.

quests.name: Into the Barrowdeep
quests.text: Find the Barrowdeep gate east of the hold, then descend into the tomb. The Cairn Thane rules those halls. End him within his cairn and return to me, $N. Let the dead finally keep their silence.
quests.completionText: The Thane has fallen. Kestrel Hold can face the winter with its roads open and its dead at rest. Take this with our thanks.

objectives.label: Cairn Thane slain in the Barrowdeep
